messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx and sustained p95/p99 on /v1/infer via runtime-cluster-5. 5xx ~17% over 6m. Suspected vectors: KV cache eviction storm + batching-window change + new q6 quant rollout. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/kv-batch_quant_incident

rahul (oncall): Acked — on cluster console. Tagging bea + nina. Any deployments in last 30m? 

bea (runtime): We promoted q6-small quant variant to 50% and increased batching-window to 60ms across cluster-5 at 2026-03-14T20:40Z to validate throughput. No infra changes. 

nina (mlops): Confirmed. Canary ramp started at 20:40Z. I'm seeing KV miss-rate spike from 6% -> 48% starting 20:43Z. Batching increase likely increased concurrency and evicted prefix caches. 

rahul (oncall): Immediate mitigations: 1) set canary weight to 0; 2) reduce batching-window back to 20ms; 3) run targeted KV cache verify + refresh for model prefixes. Executing now. 

ops-bot: Routing update: set canary q6-small -> 0% on runtime-cluster-5. 

rahul (oncall): Running cache refresh command: 
```
# targeted refresh for q6 model prefixes
redwoodctl cache prewarm --cluster runtime-cluster-5 --model q6-small --parallel 8
```

ops-bot: Prewarm job queued (approx 2.1M keys). Job id: prewarm-4421. 

bea (runtime): Logs (sanitized):
```
[20:43:12] kernel_call model=q6-small device=gpu-v100 -> quant_to_kernel: unsupported stride -> error
[20:43:12] inference id=... -> 5xx kernel_error: stride-mismatch
[20:43:13] kv_get prompt:abc123 -> miss
[20:43:14] fallback to cpu-kernel -> p99 spike
```

omar (sre): Customer impact: not widespread but two tenants experienced elevated errors and retries. Filing CS ticket now and will prepare customer note. Zoe, could you help with wording? 

zoe (product): I'll draft a short transparent line: "We briefly served increased errors during a canary that impacted a subset of infrastructure. Canary was promptly rolled back; we're investigating root cause and will share follow-up." Will post to #customer-success for review. 

rahul (oncall): After throttle + prewarm: errors dropping to ~2-3% over last 4m. p95 back to ~210ms. Marking incident as mitigated. 

omar (sre): Creating PIR and tracking remediation. Proposed PIR time: 2026-03-15 11:00 PT in #eng-runtime. Agenda suggests: sequence of events, kernel failure analysis, KV cache eviction model, batching interplay, rollout guardrails, and action owners. 

bea (runtime): Preliminary RCA: new quant path triggered a kernel op that assumes contiguous weight layout; on some older GPU drivers/instances this led to a stride mismatch and error path. High concurrency from batching made the failing codepath occur more often and increased KV churn because more parallel requests cold-started KV entries. 

nina (mlops): Proposed safeguards: 1) preflight quant compatibility test across driver versions and gpu families; 2) add per-node canary cap (max concurrent canary requests per node); 3) additive metric: kernel-fallback-count sampled during first 5m of rollout. 

rahul (oncall): Draft action items captured: 
- INF-7920: Pre-rollout compatibility test for quant kernels vs driver & gpu families (owner: nina, due: 2026-04-06)
- INF-7921: Add per-node canary concurrency cap and fail-fast on kernel-fallback > 0 in first 3m (owner: bea, due: 2026-03-29)
- INF-7922: Runbook update: explicit KV cache prewarm & validate steps and fallout checklist (owner: omar, due: 2026-03-20)
- INF-7923: Customer follow-up & SLA impact note (owner: zoe, due: 2026-03-16)

bea (runtime): I'll add an automated monitor: sample kernel-fallback-rate and tie to rollout gating. Also will add an operator-only flag to disable new kernel path per node. 

nina (mlops): I'll prepare a compatibility matrix and a small harness to run quantized kernels across our node fleet (driver permutations) before promotion. 

omar (sre): Updating incident runbook to add a quick triage flow: when canary + batching change -> watch kv-miss-rate, kernel-fallbacks, and queue-length; if kv-miss absolute delta > 10% in 2m, auto-throttle canary to 1%. Adding this to INF-7922. 

zoe (product): Once PIR notes land, I'll assemble the customer-facing post explaining steps taken and planned safeguards. 

rahul (oncall): I'm handing to night oncall in 40m. Please update the ticket INF-7920+ with progress and tag me when patches are ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident mitigated recorded by rahul at 2026-03-14T20:51:00Z. PIR scheduled: 2026-03-15T18:00:00Z PT in #eng-runtime (calendar invite sent).
